freeze_boundary: Frozen before any new closed-box control extraction. No cut-result or TASK metrics are used to select this profile.
scope: Independent renderer geometry and quadrature controls only; no cutting-physics or default renderer changes
candidate_rationale: Normalized symmetric cubic B-spline density is one half on a continuum half-space boundary. H1 uses this fixed 0.5 isovalue; volume=8*r^3=spacing^3 and support=3*spacing. Voxel size=spacing/2 resolves the kernel independently of grid phase. No fit to material target height or global mesh volume is performed.
promotion_rule: Only the fixed H1 is assessed. All development and held-out cases must pass. No alternate thresholds/kernel/voxel profiles may be selected after seeing held-out results.

criteria.reason: Half-particle p95 boundary accuracy, bounded whole-object volume bias and topological validity are geometry screens; they cannot pass a cut/flatness task. Sharp edges are included in whole-mesh statistics, never culled.

central_face_definition: Vertices within3*spacing of each finite face edge are excluded only from a separately reported face-center bias diagnostic. Full-mesh SDF/volume metrics always include all vertices/triangles.
